from __future__ import annotations

import gc
import json
import statistics
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from aspenops_nexus.hashing import canonical_hash
from aspenops_nexus.models import EvaluationRequest

writes = [
    {
        "key": f"write-{index}",
        "identifiers": {"stream": f"S{index}", "stage": index % 10},
        "value": float(index),
        "unit": "C",
    }
    for index in range(100)
]
reads = [
    {
        "key": f"read-{index}",
        "identifiers": {"stream": f"S{index}", "stage": index % 10},
        "unit": "fraction",
        "required": index % 2 == 0,
    }
    for index in range(100)
]
constraints = [
    {
        "key": f"constraint-{index}",
        "identifiers": {"stream": f"S{index % 50}"},
        "operator": ">=",
        "value": float(index),
        "unit": "fraction",
        "name": f"constraint-{index}",
        "tolerance": 1e-6,
    }
    for index in range(200)
]
balances = [
    {
        "name": f"balance-{balance_index}",
        "terms": [
            {
                "key": f"term-{term_index}",
                "identifiers": {"stream": f"S{term_index % 50}"},
                "coefficient": float(term_index + 1),
                "unit": "kg/s",
            }
            for term_index in range(20)
        ],
        "expected": 0.0,
        "abs_tol": 1e-6,
        "rel_tol": 1e-6,
        "floor": 1e-12,
    }
    for balance_index in range(20)
]
request = EvaluationRequest.from_dict(
    {
        "model_path": "model.bkp",
        "registry_path": "registry.json",
        "backend": "mock",
        "writes": writes,
        "reads": reads,
        "constraints": constraints,
        "balances": balances,
        "reset_mode": "reinitialize",
        "timeout_s": 1200.0,
        "metadata": {"source": "benchmark"},
    }
)


def legacy_document() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "model_path": request.model_path,
        "registry_path": request.registry_path,
        "backend": request.backend,
        "writes": [asdict(item) for item in request.writes],
        "reads": [asdict(item) for item in request.reads],
        "constraints": [asdict(item) for item in request.constraints],
        "balances": [asdict(item) for item in request.balances],
        "reset_mode": request.reset_mode,
        "timeout_s": request.timeout_s,
        "metadata": dict(request.metadata),
    }


def legacy_identity() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "backend": request.backend,
        "reset_mode": request.reset_mode,
        "writes": [asdict(item) for item in request.writes],
        "reads": [asdict(item) for item in request.reads],
        "constraints": [asdict(item) for item in request.constraints],
        "balances": [asdict(item) for item in request.balances],
    }


def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )


def measure(function: Callable[[], Any], *, repeats: int = 11, loops: int = 20) -> tuple[float, Any]:
    samples: list[float] = []
    result: Any = None
    for _ in range(repeats):
        gc.collect()
        started = time.perf_counter()
        for _ in range(loops):
            result = function()
        samples.append(time.perf_counter() - started)
    return statistics.median(samples), result


legacy_document_s, legacy_document_value = measure(legacy_document)
optimized_document_s, optimized_document_value = measure(request.to_dict)
legacy_identity_s, legacy_identity_value = measure(legacy_identity)
optimized_identity_s, optimized_identity_value = measure(request.physical_identity)

document_speedup = legacy_document_s / optimized_document_s
identity_speedup = legacy_identity_s / optimized_identity_s
checks = {
    "document_canonical_json_equal": canonical_json(legacy_document_value)
    == canonical_json(optimized_document_value),
    "document_direct_roundtrip": EvaluationRequest.from_dict(optimized_document_value) == request,
    "identity_exact_equal": legacy_identity_value == optimized_identity_value,
    "cache_hash_equal": canonical_hash(legacy_identity_value)
    == canonical_hash(optimized_identity_value),
    "document_faster": optimized_document_s < legacy_document_s,
    "identity_faster": optimized_identity_s < legacy_identity_s,
    "document_meaningful_speedup": document_speedup >= 2.0,
    "identity_meaningful_speedup": identity_speedup >= 2.0,
}
result = {
    "schema": "aspenops.request-serialization-benchmark/v1",
    "boundary": "Pure Python request serialization benchmark; not licensed Aspen solve evidence.",
    "request_shape": {
        "writes": len(request.writes),
        "reads": len(request.reads),
        "constraints": len(request.constraints),
        "balances": len(request.balances),
        "balance_terms": sum(len(balance.terms) for balance in request.balances),
    },
    "before_seconds": {
        "to_dict": legacy_document_s,
        "physical_identity": legacy_identity_s,
    },
    "after_seconds": {
        "to_dict": optimized_document_s,
        "physical_identity": optimized_identity_s,
    },
    "speedups": {
        "to_dict": document_speedup,
        "physical_identity": identity_speedup,
    },
    "checks": checks,
    "decision": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
}
output = Path("var/request-serialization-efficiency/benchmark.json")
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
if result["decision"] != "PASS":
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
